title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI gating enhancements and metrics integration
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: teams need faster feedback on per-prompt regressions and clearer metrics in CI to prevent silent quality drift. This PR enhances the per-prompt gating logic, wires additional evaluation metrics into CI dashboards, and improves failure reporting so owners can triage regressions faster. Summary of changes: 1) add per-prompt delta thresholds and dynamic retry policy; 2) expose per-prompt precision/recall/F1 and MRR into CI artifacts; 3) add a lightweight local runner mode for deterministic per-prompt replay; 4) surface gating decisions and historical windowed baselines in the CI summary comment. Checklist: - [x] implement gating rule updates; - [x] add metrics exporters and CI artifact uploads; - [x] add unit and integration tests; - [x] update docs and runbook; - [x] add migration for existing per-prompt baseline snapshots. Impact: non-breaking for consumers of the eval-harness API but changes CI behavior and the gating config format requires a migration step documented in docs/eval-harness/ci.md. See linked Linear items for rollout plan and canary schedule.
